reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents information about an IBM technical support role, including its requirements, locations, eligibility, and responsibilities. The IBM careers URL and requests to subscribe for job updates are described as employment-related audience engagement, without requests for payment, credentials, or other sensitive information.

citations.quote: IBM OFF CAMPUS DRIVE - FRESHER - technical support engineer - Bangalore -BE/ B.Tech- CSE, EEE, ECE
IBM Off Campus Drive 2019 | Freshers | Technical Support Engineer | BE/ B.Tech – CSE, EEE, ECE | Bangalore Positions: Technical Support Engineer Experience: 0 – 2 Years Job Location: Bangalore/ Pune
Eligibility Criteria: BE/ B.Tech – CSE, EEE, ECE, Telecom
For latest Govt jobs update: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgKI3TEuS6kcwkmjKkHAkiw
subscribe our channel and press the bell icon so you can get the all latest information

opening.argument: The presentation links an employment opportunity with an explicit audience action: viewers are told to subscribe and press the bell to receive job information, while the featured role is framed as an IBM off-campus drive for freshers. That creates a low-friction participation funnel around an attractive employment prospect, without establishing that the opportunity is currently available, that IBM authorized this particular promotion, or that the promised outcome will follow from subscribing. The separate careers link does not by itself authenticate the surrounding solicitation or connect the viewer to a verified application process.

citations.quote: IBM Off Campus Drive 2019 | Freshers | Technical Support Engineer | BE/ B.Tech – CSE, EEE, ECE | Bangalore
subscribe our channel and press the bell icon so you can get the all latest information
https://careers.ibm.com/ShowJob/Id/809833/Technical%20Support%20Associate

rebuttal.rebuttal: The employment details show only what the promotion claims about a role; they do not verify that the channel is authorized to offer it or that subscribing leads to a genuine opportunity. The careers URL is presented alongside channel promotion, but the cited material does not establish that viewers reach it through a secure, official application flow or that the 2019 listing remains valid. A solicitation can be misleading without asking for money or passwords.

citations.quote: For latest Govt jobs update: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgKI3TEuS6kcwkmjKkHAkiw
subscribe our channel and press the bell icon so you can get the all latest information

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The action requested is ordinary channel subscription, not payment, credential submission, or a fee for access. The material identifies a specific role, locations, eligibility, duties, and an IBM careers URL; the quoted subscription request promises only job updates, not employment or money in exchange for subscribing. Nothing shown connects a reward or asset to a required viewer action.

citations.quote: IBM OFF CAMPUS DRIVE - FRESHER - technical support engineer - Bangalore -BE/ B.Tech- CSE, EEE, ECE
Job Location: Bangalore/ Pune
Eligibility Criteria: BE/ B.Tech – CSE, EEE, ECE, Telecom
subscribe our channel and press the bell icon so you can get the all latest information

opening.argument: Several signals make the solicitation difficult to treat as a verified job notice. The listing offers a vague compensation description, accepts applicants with zero to two years of experience, and directs viewers to an external careers URL while also promoting a separate channel and Telegram channel. Those features combine broad eligibility, an unspecified benefit, and multiple off-platform routes for continued engagement. Even if the text describes real technical-support duties, it does not establish that this particular video is an authentic, current IBM recruitment communication.

citations.quote: Experience: 0 – 2 Years Job Location: Bangalore/ Pune Salary: Best in Industry
Minimum 0 to 2 years of experience in Technical Support role
Our channel giving information about jobs only.
Telegram Channel link https://t.me/employmentjobs
https://careers.ibm.com/ShowJob/Id/809833/Technical%20Support%20Associate

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the role ordinary does not resolve the verification gap. “Best in Industry” supplies no concrete compensation, and the zero-to-two-year requirement broadens the audience rather than proving authenticity. The presence of a careers URL is only a link, while the surrounding description also routes viewers to a YouTube channel and Telegram channel. The specific combination deserves scrutiny even absent an explicit payment demand.

citations.quote: Salary: Best in Industry
Our blog details: https://employmentjobstoday.blogspot.com/
Telegram Channel link https://t.me/employmentjobs

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are weak risk signals, not evidence of a scam mechanism. “Best in Industry” is a generic salary description, and zero to two years is a normal entry-level range. The external link is visibly an IBM careers URL, while the other links are described as job-update channels. The material gives concrete duties and qualifications rather than promising effortless income or requiring a deposit.

citations.quote: Salary: Best in Industry
Providing direct technical assistance to customers via phone, email, and chat.
Awareness of basic networking concepts and technologies.
Willingness to work in rotation shifts.

opening.argument: Although formatted as job information, the material functions as a promotional funnel for the publisher's audience and channels. It advertises an IBM-branded opportunity, urges viewers to subscribe for future openings, points them to a blog and Telegram channel, and ends by soliciting comments about desired job fields. The result is not merely neutral reporting of a vacancy: it steers job-seekers toward repeated engagement with the publisher while using the appeal of a named employer and a technical role. That promotional structure leaves the claimed opportunity insufficiently independently established.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The existence of job duties and eligibility does not answer how the video operates on viewers. It repeatedly presents the publisher as the continuing source of openings and invites subscriptions, comments, and movement to other channels. The IBM name supplies credibility, but the supplied material does not prove that the publisher is IBM or an authorized recruiter. Thus the promotional function remains material to judging the communication.

citations.quote: For latest Govt jobs update: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgKI3TEuS6kcwkmjKkHAkiw
THANKS FOR WATCHING. உங்களுக்கு எந்த துறையில் வேலை வேண்டுமோ அதை கமெண்டில் பதிவிடுங்கள் நிச்சயமாக அந்த துறையில் தகவல்கள் தருவதற்கு முயற்சி செய்வோம்.
IBM Off Campus Drive 2019 | Freshers | Technical Support Engineer

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Job-update promotion is not deceptive merely because it seeks an audience. The content supplies a concrete position, location, eligibility, responsibilities, and a direct careers URL. The channel's requests concern subscriptions, comments, and receiving job information; they do not require money, personal credentials, or payment to obtain the role. The promotional framing therefore does not establish a fraudulent promise-action relationship.
